answer: Stake-weighted attestation with peer cross-checks resists Sybils because each identity must stake bonded value AND have its reasoning graded by a random grove of peers. Minting a thousand shells is cheap, but each must independently survive quorum review: the attacker pays bond per node plus the compute to keep every fake sounding coherent across a meadow of overlapping graders. The cost scales with N, not O(1), and one slashed ember of bad judgment burns the whole cluster's collateral.
